fullPassage: To demonstrate how best to defeat the habit of delaying, Dan Ariely, a professor of psychology and behavioral economics, performed an experiment on students in three of his classes at MIT. He assigned all classes three reports over the course of the semester. The first class had to choose three due dates for themselves, up to and including the last day of class. The second had no deadlines — all three papers just had to be submitted by the last day of class. In his third class, he gave students three set deadlines over the course of the semester. At the end of the semester, he found that students with set deadlines received the best grades, the students with no deadlines had the worst, and those who could choose their own deadlines fell somewhere in the middle. Ariely concludes that restricting freedom — whether by the professor or by students who recognize their own tendencies to delay things — improves self-control and performance.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 명사 behavior(행동)를 형용사형 behavioral(행동의)로 변환합니다. 뒤의 명사 economics(경제학)를 꾸며 주어야 하므로 형용사가 필요해요. 'behavioral economics(행동 경제학)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: 명사 뒤 명사를 꾸미려면 형용사로! behavior → behavioral economics(행동 경제학)

questions.passage: Restricting freedom — whether by the professor or by students who recognize their own __________ (tendency) to delay things — improves self-control and performance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 명사 tendency(성향)를 복수형 tendencies로 변환합니다. their own(그들 자신의)이 꾸미고 있고 여러 학생의 성향을 가리키므로 복수형이 자연스러워요. -y로 끝나는 명사는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여 tendencies가 됩니다.
det.tip: 자음 + y로 끝나면 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es! tendency → tendencies

questions.passage: To demonstrate how best to defeat the habit of delaying, Dan Ariely, a professor of psychology and behavioral economics, performed an experiment on students in three of his classes at MIT. He assigned all classes three reports over the course of the semester. The first class had to choose three due dates for themselves, up to and including the last day of class. The second had no deadlines — all three papers just had to be submitted by the last day of class. In his third class, he gave students three set deadlines over the course of the semester. At the end of the semester, he found that students with set deadlines received the best grades, the students with no deadlines had the worst, and those who could __________ fell somewhere in the middle. Ariely concludes that restricting freedom — whether by the professor or by students who recognize their own tendencies to delay things — improves self-control and performance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 첫 번째 반은 스스로 마감일을 정해야 했다
det.analysis:
✅ ① choose their own deadlines: 첫 번째 반은 학기 마지막 날까지의 범위에서 '스스로 마감일을 정해야' 했다는 실험 조건 ←정답
❌ ② skip all the reports: 모든 반이 세 개의 보고서를 제출해야 했으므로 반대
❌ ③ study during vacations: 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ receive extra rewards: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: The first class had to ______ → 스스로 마감일을 정하다(choose their own deadlines)

questions.passage: To demonstrate how best to defeat the habit of delaying, Dan Ariely, a professor of psychology and behavioral economics, performed an experiment on students in three of his classes at MIT. He assigned all classes three reports over the course of the semester. The first class had to choose three due dates for themselves, up to and including the last day of class. The second had no deadlines — all three papers just had to be submitted by the last day of class. In his third class, he gave students three set deadlines over the course of the semester. At the end of the semester, he found that students with set deadlines received the best grades, the students with no deadlines had the worst, and those who could choose their own deadlines __________. Ariely concludes that restricting freedom — whether by the professor or by students who recognize their own tendencies to delay things — improves self-control and performance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 스스로 마감일을 정한 학생들은 중간쯤의 성적을 받았다
det.analysis:
❌ ① received the best grades: 최고 성적은 정해진 마감일이 있던 학생들의 결과
❌ ② failed the entire course: 본문에 없는 내용
✅ ③ fell somewhere in the middle: 정해진 마감일(최고)과 마감일 없음(최악) 사이에서 스스로 정한 학생은 '중간쯤에 위치했다'는 결과 ←정답
❌ ④ left the class early: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: those who could choose their own deadlines ______ → 중간에 위치(fell somewhere in the middle)
